title: Armor: Shoulders
description: Replicate the shoulder armor piece from Blender-Procedural-Human in Ixdar DSL. Source: procedural_human/geo_node_groups/armor/shoulders.py. Key techniques: Bezier curves, curve-to-mesh, instance-on-points, arc geometry, gem placement. Reference neck_armor.dsl for proven bi_rail_loft + pipes + rivets pattern.
definition-of-done: 1. shoulders.dsl compiles without errors. 2. Mesh comparison gate passes (similarity >= 70%, coverage >= 50%, proximity >= 60%). 3. Visual comparison shows recognizable silhouette match to Blender reference.
testing-plan: 1. Export Blender reference OBJ. 2. Run validate-dsl to export generated OBJ. 3. Run mesh_distance() comparison. 4. Visual inspection via automation screenshot.
